binding_policy.exploration: Coherent whole-passage hypotheses may be authored before confirmed words or an independent discriminator. For each actually proposed native meaning, first retrieve the exact-form profile and claim-bearing prior evidence; justify its priority using dispersion, positions, repetitions and counterexamples. Unknown/unsupported meanings remain unassigned. Use shared rules and show all costs, gaps and rivals.
binding_policy.fixed_comparison: Before selecting a new fixed comparison or claiming a semantic preference, specify the relevant shared rules, scope, rivals and genuinely different predicted consequences. Acquire additional independent binding where that claim requires it. A matching source file or a hypothetical fluent story does not prove a gate.
